author: eserz
body:
It's not only viable with cerus adornments, but realmshifter it's a class that relies on crits to deal most of its damage and the best crit adorn is cerus.

So basically it's viable without cerus, no problems there, but it's better with cerus

author: petr1petr
body:
it is not a must - some people actually refuse crits.

But I would say that 80% of players love crits - not only nyx/RS

there are more crit adorns, not only cerus.

it is all about dmg - it is great to have, but you can live without it - also, if you are not using any skills that can crit, you dont need it. 

But if I were you, I would learn more about it and maybe you will like it after all

author: Phractal33
body: Also, the adorn is insanely useful across all classes, Heretic maybe more so than RS.  however you view it, those WRB Cerus adorns are top tier, get over 50 of them, at least.

author: denz75
body: Ferocious bull eyes are currently the best crit adornments in the game so any class that likes to crit would like to use of them. Not to mention you can easily reach 100% of crit chance by putting them into some 2h weapon with many slots when paired with wyrms song and base skill crit
